collection.description: A keeper records a golden glimmer appearing at dusk near a Canary Fire-Arrow, tied in stories to the Golden Guppy.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A keeper records a golden glimmer appearing at dusk near a Canary Fire-Arrow, a fish associated in island stories with the Golden Guppy. Some call it magic, others point to water, food, chance, or observation error.

choices.label: Compare clear-walled rectangular containers and conditions

text_only.reason: explanations offered; no food is gained or lost

a.name: Answer A
a.text: A small ceremony comforts the keeper and draws attention to the fish, without proving causation.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The keeper controls feeding and water changes; results are suggestive but not decisive.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The magician reports a meaningful sensation; a skeptical apprentice records only what can be measured.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: The animal thrives or fades according to ordinary conditions; its mystery remains unresolved.
